scope: Isolated automated API/database regressions and Inventory/POS Flask tests; no live customer data changed.
limitations: All 50 complete browser workflows remain unverified.
SQLite tests do not establish PostgreSQL concurrency or migration behavior.
No external reminders or invoice messages were sent.
Existing customer balances were not backfilled; the posting fix applies to future transactions.
fixes: Reject insufficient, negative, invalid, or excessive noncash tenders before stock or financial posting.
Subtract returned split-payment cash change from the cash drawer total.
Include Cash In movements in closing cash and the Z report.
Prevent duplicate recall of recalled or deleted held bills and require the original open session.
Reject zero/invalid sale lines before posting.
Prevent completed/cancelled manufacturing orders from posting again; use actual output and BOM yield for component quantities and costs.
Reject purchase order over-receipts, mismatched lines/warehouses, and receipts against cancelled/completed POs.
Post the full sale debit before the receipt so paid cash sales leave zero stored customer balance.
Exclude sales tax from revenue and calculate gross profit from sold item costs; show gross margin and restockable return cost reversals.
